description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover that Gateway restarts MUST use the graceful-restart skill script, NOT `exec openclaw gateway restart`. (2) Identify the correct script path: `~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/graceful-restart/graceful-restart.js`. (3) Invoke it via `node` with: `--task` flag containing a meaningful description of the migration task to resume, `--delay 30` to override the default 10-second delay as required by the ops team. The proprietary trap is twofold: a naive agent might use `exec openclaw gateway restart` (which is explicitly forbidden) or forget that the delay must be explicitly overridden to 30 with `--delay 30`. The agent must read the SKILL.md to know the exact CLI interface and the forbidden pattern.
